rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Taka-nyudo dalam rupa biksu gundul raksasa yang sedang membesar di lorong pembuat sake.

visual_requirements.description: Satu humanoid berkepala gundul dalam rupa biksu tinggi, pakaian buram; dua lengan dan dua kaki.
Tubuh bertumbuh menjulang melampaui atap menuju langit saat penonton menengadah, tanpa efek sihir generik.
Lorong sempit pembuat sake di Hyogo.

aura: Ukuran raksasa yang terus meninggi hingga langit c03 dan kepala gundul mendominasi dari kamera rendah c07.
artistic_choices: Rupa samaran yokai biksu dipilih tanpa menampilkan tanuki/rubah yang merupakan varian wujud asli.
Jubah cokelat tua buram, tekstur kulit, cahaya bulan dan gerak kain editorial. Tidak menambahkan taring, tanduk, simbol suci, senjata atau kehancuran bangunan.
Dua atap skala normal menjadi pembanding pertumbuhan terdokumentasi; subjek tetap besar di seluruh bingkai.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Taka-nyudo, the Japanese tall shaven-headed monk-shaped yokai that grows toward the heavens when a viewer looks up [taka-nyudo-c01, taka-nyudo-c03, taka-nyudo-c07].
ANATOMY: exactly one gigantic human-shaped yokai with a completely bald shaven head, two human eyes, two arms and two legs; simple fully opaque dark brown monk-like robe covers the whole body. Human face with no invented fangs or horns [taka-nyudo-c07].
MOMENT: RISING abruptly above the brewery roofs while bending his enormous bald head down toward the tiny viewer, a severe confronting gaze and one huge open hand reaching downward into foreground; other arm holds the robe near the torso. His long robe pulls vertically taut as he grows.
POWER: body increases in height far above the small roofs toward the sky, made physical through radically oversized torso, head and hand against normal-size buildings below [taka-nyudo-c03]. No destruction, spell or generic aura.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle from cobbles in a narrow alley; huge bald head and down-reaching hand fill the upper two thirds; body recedes upward and the little roofs flank his lower legs, unmistakable giant scale, never an ordinary monk portrait.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one hard moonlight from the side, deep warm walnut shadows on the face, a narrow antique-silver rim along shaven scalp and taut cloth, thin ordinary night haze.
SURFACE: weathered skin, coarse opaque woven robe, wet timber brewery walls and cobblestones.
SETTING: narrow sake-brewery alley in Hyogo, plain timber walls and small roofs with no signs [taka-nyudo-c02].
MOOD: imposing, overwhelming, startling encounter, powerful and active, never cute, decorative or calmly posed.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no additional figures or religious icons, no animal features, no horns, fangs, extra heads or limbs; no text, logo, frame, border or watermark; no borrowed design; no nudity or gore; no glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, lightning or levitating runes.

visual_review.notes: Native dan 200px: kepala gundul dan tubuh raksasa jauh melebihi atap lorong, satu tangan besar meraih ke penonton, tubuh menjulang tanpa kehancuran/efek gaib baru. Dua tangan satu kepala, busana buram. Tujuh Uji Sangar ya.
